mapper.sql: ID AS id, TENANT_REF_ID AS tenantRefId, MEMBER_REF_ID AS memberRefId, APP_REF_ID AS appRefId, ROLE_REF_ID AS roleRefId, SCOPE_TYPE AS scopeType, SCOPE_REF_ID AS scopeRefId, STATUS AS status, IS_DELETE AS isDelete, VERSION AS version, DELETED_AT AS deletedAt
mapper.select: SELECT M.ID AS id, M.TENANT_REF_ID AS tenantRefId, M.USER_REF_ID AS userRefId, M.STATUS AS status, M.IS_DELETE AS isDelete, M.VERSION AS version, M.AUTH_VERSION AS authVersion FROM PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M INNER JOIN PEACH_USER U ON U.ID = M.USER_REF_ID AND U.IS_DELETE = 0 AND U.STATUS IN ('1','ENABLE') INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = M.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' WHERE M.ID = #{memberRefId} AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PEACH_ROLE R INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = R.APP_REF_ID AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = R.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.TENANT_ID = A.TENANT_ID AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' WHERE R.ID = #{roleRefId} AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND R.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 AND R.ROLE_TYPE = 'TENANT'

SELECT P.PERMISSION_CODE FROM PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND P.DELEGABLE = 1 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId}) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId})) WHERE RP.ROLE_REF_ID = #{roleRefId} AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0
SELECT FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING WHERE TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND IS_DELETE = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING (ID, TENANT_REF_ID, MEMBER_REF_ID, APP_REF_ID, ROLE_REF_ID, SCOPE_TYPE, SCOPE_REF_ID, STATUS, IS_DELETE, VERSION, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantRefId}, #{memberRefId}, #{appRefId}, #{roleRefId}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeRefId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ACTIVE', 0, 0, #{createdTime}, #{creatorId})
mapper.sql: FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M ON M.ID = B.MEMBER_REF_ID AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND A.TENANT_ID = T.TENANT_ID AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.PERMISSION_CODE = 'TENANT.MEMBER.MANAGE' AND P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID) AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0 AND B.SCOPE_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND B.SCOPE_REF_ID IS NULL AND B.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_TENANT_OWNER' AND R.ROLE_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE B.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND B.MEMBER_REF_ID = #{memberRefId} AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_TENANT_OWNER' AND R.ROLE_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE B.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND B.ID = #{bindingRefId} AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0
